findings.summary: The complete current Toast surface contains 187 unique in-scope food and nonalcoholic products; the 20-row frozen baseline is a severe under-extraction. Twelve frozen rows map current and eight are stale.
All four required allergen searches completed without a formal matrix or cross-contact policy; direct allergen data remains accurately unavailable.
